description: This file defines the React context and provider for authentication within a React application. It manages user session state, authentication methods (email and Google OAuth), and provides hooks for other components to access auth data.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component that provides authentication context to its children.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook for accessing authentication context data.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Hook to retrieve the current user's role from the auth context.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Alias hook for useAuth, for compatibility purposes.

methods.name: signInWithEmail
methods.description: Function to initiate email sign-in via magic link.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Function to sign out the current user.
